what_is_not_verified: not a fresh liveness probe of Feishu or subject processes
not a full raw-log independent validation of every coordinator failure attribution
not a measured overall framework ranking
not a new subject or model run
decisions: Retain v1 as calibration/smoke evidence; do not count final accepted cases as first-pass independent successes.
No more mobile login, device-switch or Feishu work merely to fill 24; deferred W5 stays untested unless a low-burden first-party path is available.
Compare W6 by ownership and disconnect semantics; Codex CLI and app-server observations are different surfaces, not interchangeable repeated samples.
Separate coordinator defects, legitimate product setup burden, product task failure, safe refusal, and environmental unavailability.
Retain all incurred time/cost in project accounting; only comparable valid samples enter product performance/cost comparison.
Do not infer Codex cost 0 from an empty/zero API charge when it consumes a subscription.
Calibrate representative tasks before formal repetitions; do not run 216 repetitions of a low-discrimination smoke pack.
Retain architecture-specific tests for recovery, security, control, scaling and audit; complex deliverables alone cannot establish 11 quality attributes.
Models remain deepseek-flash for OC/Hermes/DSH and gpt-6.1-sol for Codex; Claude and model routing remain excluded.
Any revised task/protocol gets a new version; preserve immutable v1 and prior outcomes. No additional paid runs authorized by this review.
